turns.question: How many leads did every 100 euros of social ad spend get us in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no leads-per-100-euros metric (I won't compute the inverse myself); the closest is cost per lead, which for social ads from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 was 52.5 EUR per lead (ad spend 2,100 EUR, 40 leads). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
